standard: BDS DD elements v1 (Promote v1) — DRAFT

rules.why: DD: an exterior wall is the office's external CMU at the wall type's width.
DD: an interior wall is the office's gypsum partition at the wall type's width.

DD (DRAFT FL-1): an interior floor is the office's structural concrete slab at the floor type's thickness. BDS has 150, 300 and 450 mm; any other thickness is a gap. Exterior floors have no rule (FL-2).
DD (DRAFT RF-1): a basic roof is the office's one roof type at the roof type's thickness; only 300 mm exists. BDS_EXT_ARC_GENRC is itself a generic build-up: an office type, not a detailed roof.
DD (DRAFT CL-2): a layered ceiling is the office's gypsum ceiling at the ceiling type's thickness; only 50 mm exists. A Basic Ceiling has no build-up and no rule (CL-1).

DD (DRAFT DR-1, DR-3, DR-5, DR-6): an interior door with a 1000 x 2100 opening is the office's single-leaf wood door. The size is the nominal size in the BDS type name; the family's own Width/Height (960 x 1980) is the leaf.

DD (DRAFT DR-1, DR-3, DR-5, DR-6): an interior door with a 2000 x 2100 opening is the office's double-leaf wood door. The size is the nominal size in the BDS type name; the family's own Width/Height (980 x 2080) is one leaf.
DD (DRAFT WN-1): the only BDS window at 600 x 1200.
